# Evidence & Completeness Gates Checklist: Comprehensive live QuickFIX interop conversation

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review of the identity, ledger, manifest, validation-pair and completeness-gate clauses (FR-013…FR-015d, W-*, E-*). Tests whether those requirements are written well enough to implement without re-deriving intent.
**Created**: 2026-09-10
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [data-model.md](../data-model.md) · [contracts/witness-evidence.md](../contracts/witness-evidence.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

> ⚠️ This is the cluster where an entity was **schemad, constrained by E-7 and armed in Step 4 while no
> artifact held it and no command produced it** — so zero pairs was green through every gate. The RC-A
> rule exists because of it. These items test whether that rule now holds across the whole cluster.

## Producer Obligations (RC-A)

- [ ] CHK001 Does every entity in `data-model.md` resolve to a row in `plan.md` § *External obligations* naming both the file it lands in **and** the command that produces it? [Completeness, Plan §RC-A]
- [ ] CHK002 Are the two deliberate exceptions (§7 the hand-authored script, §8 the disk-preflight reading) stated **as exceptions with reasons**, rather than simply absent? [Clarity, Plan §RC-A]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the RC-A sweep expressed so it can be re-run mechanically, rather than requiring a reader to judge whether prose constitutes a producer? [Measurability, Plan §External obligations]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the hazard that `data-model.md`'s section numbering is **not contiguous** — so a `## N.` pattern silently drops `## 1a.` — recorded where the sweep is performed? [Coverage, Plan §RC-A]
- [ ] CHK005 Are requirements defined for what happens when a gate ranges over a field that has no producer, i.e. is "the RC-A shape" named as a defect class? [Clarity, Plan §RC-A]

## Identity Model

- [ ] CHK006 Is the separation of **logical cell** from **run** stated once, normatively, with `cell_id ≡ (combo_id, arm)` given rather than implied? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013a]
- [ ] CHK007 Are the two identity keys — observed-row uniqueness and the **stable completeness key** — distinguished with an explicit statement of what each is for? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015a]
- [ ] CHK008 Is `direction`'s vocabulary reachable from every artifact that defines a record carrying it, and stated as **absolute** rather than relative to the emitting process? [Consistency, Spec §Conversation census]
- [ ] CHK009 Are requirements defined for `occurrence` such that a repeat of `(seq_num, direction)` with no distinguishing ordinal is specified as a violation? [Edge Case, Contract §C-9]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the manifest row identity `(cell_id, config)` stated with its cardinality (32 rows) and with the rule that retries never reach it? [Completeness, Contract §E-1a]

## Corroboration & Promotion

- [ ] CHK011 Is the requirement that **only** the named promotion command may write a `status: pass` row stated exclusively, so no second writer is permitted by omission? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014b]
- [ ] CHK012 Are the promotion command's inputs specified — both streams, a `hello` **and** a `terminal` on each — rather than left as "the artifacts"? [Completeness, Contract §E-1b]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the requirement for a **machine-independent** reference to the ledger entry stated together with its negative (never an absolute path into a run directory)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014b]
- [ ] CHK014 Are requirements defined distinguishing a stream that is **present** from one that **agrees** — so a fixture can separate the two? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK015 Is the ordering requirement — promote after a config's 8 cells and **before** its build tree is reclaimed — stated as a constraint with its reason? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014b]
- [ ] CHK016 Are requirements defined for `counterparty_version` sourced from the **hello**, with the reason (a config says what was requested, the hello says what ran)? [Traceability, Contract §E-2]

## Completeness Gate (π and the inventories)

- [ ] CHK017 Is the expected witness set required to be **derived from the conversation script**, with hand-listing excluded explicitly? [Clarity, Contract §W-2]
- [ ] CHK018 Is the independence rule for W-2a's two operands stated strongly enough that generating one from the other is identified as **deleting** the criterion rather than satisfying it? [Clarity, Plan §SC-009a's two operands]
- [ ] CHK019 Are π's scoping rules — `kind: conformance` only, `authoritative: true` only — stated at every site that ranges over runs, or pointed at a single normative home? [Consistency, Contract §W-3a]
- [ ] CHK020 Is the 32-slot rule expressed as set **equality**, never containment, and is the difference called out? [Measurability, Contract §W-3b]
- [ ] CHK021 Are requirements defined for the case where a whole configuration is absent, given that the **union is unchanged** and a single deleted witness does not exercise it? [Edge Case, Coverage]
- [ ] CHK022 Is the accumulate-across-configs rule stated with its negative (a later config must not overwrite an earlier one's rows)? [Completeness, Contract §W-4]
- [ ] CHK023 Is the second reading after the last configuration specified as **a second reading, never the only one**? [Clarity, Contract §W-5]
- [ ] CHK024 Are requirements defined for an observed occurrence count differing from the census-declared count as **its own** classification, distinct from a field-level `missing`? [Clarity, Contract §W-7]

## Validation Pairs

- [ ] CHK025 Is a validation pair required to name **two distinct runs with opposite arms**, stated positively rather than only as a prohibition? [Clarity, Contract §E-7]
- [ ] CHK026 Are the pair-set completeness requirements (the 16-pair inventory) stated separately from pair **well-formedness**, so that 15 well-formed pairs is specified as a failure? [Completeness, Contract §E-7a]
- [ ] CHK027 Is the requirement for at least one `validator-positive-control` pair stated with its `authoritative` scoping? [Coverage, Contract §E-7b]
- [ ] CHK028 Is E-7c's scoping to `authoritative: true` pairs stated with the reason an unscoped version would be permanently RED on every correctly recorded retry? [Clarity, Contract §E-7c]
- [ ] CHK029 Are the demotion triggers specified with a single normative home rather than restated at each referencing site? [Consistency, Data-model §10]
- [ ] CHK030 Is the rule that a control run **can** be superseded stated explicitly, rather than inferred from how it starts? [Ambiguity, Data-model §11]

## Terminal States & Failure Vocabulary

- [ ] CHK031 Is the status vocabulary stated as a **closed** set, with the extension mechanism named? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014a]
- [ ] CHK032 Are requirements defined for an `ENOSPC` abort as its own terminal state, with the four states it must **not** be recorded as enumerated? [Clarity, Contract §E-5]
- [ ] CHK033 Is the conditional nature of the extended required-field set (`kind: conversation` only) stated with the consequence of making it unconditional — the 59 committed rows? [Coverage, Plan §External obligations]
- [ ] CHK034 Are requirements defined for the schema check **not** opening any artifact path, with the reason (a ctest on runners holding no run artifacts)? [Clarity, Plan §External obligations]
- [ ] CHK035 Is a stream carrying a `hello` and no `terminal` specified as an incomplete run rather than a pass, at every site that reads a hello? [Consistency, Contract §C-10]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK036 Do `cell_results.yaml` and `witness_evidence.yaml` requirements agree on which artifact owns which level of the two-level result shape? [Consistency, Spec §FR-015a]
- [ ] CHK037 Is any requirement in this cluster stated as a **count** where the count will rot, rather than as a condition plus a re-derivation recipe? [Clarity, Gap]
- [ ] CHK038 Are the terms *slot*, *run*, *cell*, *row* and *witness* used with stable meanings across spec, data-model and the evidence contract? [Consistency]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
